home.emergencyHotlinesDesc: Bika izi nimero. Mu bihe by'ingorane:
home.faq1A: Iyandikishe kubuntu, ujye ku Ohereza raporo. Hitamo imyiri, ubwoko n'ahantu.

about.title: Ibiterekeye ServicePulse
about.missionText: ServicePulse ni porogaramu y'itangazo ry'imiryango y'igihugu ikoresha uburyo buhindagurika, ihuzanya abaturage n'imiryango nkenerwa biciye kuri SMS na rubuga, kugira ngo amakuru nkenerwa ageze ku bose nta cyerekezo cya interineti.
about.challengeText: Kutagira interineti bihagije ni ingorane mu Rwanda no muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba. Nubwo interineti igeze mu maso, abaturage benshi basigara bakoresha telefoni zisanzwe. ServicePulse isubiza iki biciye kubumba amatangazo ya SMS na rubuga.
about.solution1: Abarurage bafata amatangazo ya SMS ku cyicaro
about.solution2: Abarurage bashobora kohereza raporo biciye kuri rubuga
about.solution3: Imyiri y'igihugu icunga amatangazo no kubona amaporoporo
about.solution4: Kumenya aho amakenga ahuriye bituma hatangwa icyubahiro
about.visionText: ServicePulse yubatse kugira ngo yongere. Ishyirwa ryawo risingiza kwagura muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba, hamwe n'imiryango mishya, ibarura n'uburyo bwikoreye. Iyi porogaramu ni ishingiro rya digital ubutegetsi bubanziriza kubona no guhuza abaturage.

howItWorks.title: Uko bikora
howItWorks.step1Desc: Fungura konti n'email, nimero ya telefoni n'ahantu. Emera amategeko kugira ngo utangire.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Hitamo kufata amatangazo ya SMS n'imiryango ushaka (Amashanyarazi, Amazi, Serivisi zihutira).
howItWorks.step3Desc: Fata amatangazo ya SMS ku cyicaro cyawe iyo haba amakenga. Nta interineti ukeneye.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Ohereza raporo z'ibibazo biciye kuri rubuga. Reba uko zitegerezwa kuva ku gusohora kugeza ku gusubiza.
howItWorks.agencyStep1Desc: Abakoresha imyiri bafata rubuga rw'imiryango yabo (REG, WASAC, cyangwa Serivisi zihutira).
howItWorks.agencyStep2Desc: Kurema amatangazo ya SMS ku gusoza n'ahantu. Reba ubutumwa mbere yo gukohereza abaturage.
howItWorks.agencyStep3Desc: Injira mu bo atumizi kugira ngo ubone amaporoporo y'abaturage. Sokora ku cyicaro, ubwoko cyangwa imiterere.
howItWorks.agencyStep4Desc: Hindura imiterere y'amaporoporo (Yakiriwe → Irakorwa → Yarasubijwe) no kumenya aho amakenga ahuriye.

auth.resetPasswordDesc: Injiza imeyili cyangwa nimero ya terefone kugira ngo tuohereze link yo gusubira gushiraho ijambo ryibanga.
auth.resetLinkSent: Niba konti iriho, uzahabwa link mu kanya gato.

terms.title: Amategeko n'amabwiriza
terms.section1Text: Mu koresha ServicePulse, wemera kandi wemerana n'amategeko y'iyi sogokuru.
terms.section2Text: Wahawe uburenganzira bwo gukoresha ServicePulse gato mu buryo bwo kwiga. Ibi si ugutanga, kandi kuri iyi lisansi ntushobora:
terms.section3Text: Wiyubahiriza kubika konti yawe n'ijambo ryibanga. Wemera kwiyubahiriza ibintu byose bivuka ku konti yawe.
terms.section4Text: Gukoresha ServicePulse bigenga na Polisi y'Ibanga. Soma Polisi y'Ibanga kugira ngo utahura uko dukora.
terms.section5Text: ServicePulse iranira guha serivisi nziza ariko ntizisingiza kubona buri gihe. Dufite uburenganzira bwo guhindura cyangwa guhagarika serivisi igihe icyo ari cyo.
terms.section6Text: ServicePulse ntizizahari igihe haba impanuka zivuka mu koresha cyangwa kutakoresha serivisi.

privacy.title: Polisi y'Ibanga
privacy.section2a: Kohereze amatangazo ya SMS ku cyicaro
privacy.section3Text: Dukoresha uburyo bwo kubungabunga amakuru yawe n'abatabifitiye uburenganzira.
privacy.section4Text: Urashobora guhitamo kufata cyangwa kutafata SMS igihe icyo ari cyo mu gakanya kawe.
privacy.section5Text: Ntiturgurisha amakuru yawe. Dushobora gusangira amakuru atandukanye n'imyiri kugira ngo du noze serivisi.
privacy.section7Text: Niba ufite ibibazo kuri Polisi y'Ibanga, twandikire biciye kuri porogaramu cyangwa imyiri.
